{{Top}}
{{Quote|Any battlefield medic would be proud to have done as much.|Han Solo|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Medic_TofG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] medic]]
A '''medic''', sometimes referred to as a '''med-tech''',<ref name="Ship Jackers">{{JournalCite|13|Special Ops: Ship Jackers}}</ref> was a title held both by medical technicians in medical facilities and by soldiers that carried [[Supply pack|medical supplies]] into the battlefield and tended to wounded soldiers. They were present in many armies including the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Medics in known armies==
*On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] used a certain type of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] as its medic, while the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] used [[Royal med droid]]s.<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

*The [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] and later the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] did not require medics, but used [[MED-47]] medical droids and [[ADK-25-MED medical droid]]s, respectively, when dealing with organic individuals.<ref name="SW:GB" />

*[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] used [[Wookiee medical droid|their own design of medical droid]].<ref name="SW:GB" />

*[[Clone medic/Legends|Clone trooper medics]] were [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that acted as medics on the battlefield. They were trained as medics on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and received special tools to help their fellow wounded troopers. These medics were also experienced troopers and often served near the front line of combat. Notable battles they were involved with were the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]] and the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]]. The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] also used [[IM-6 Battlefield Medical Droid/Legends|IM-6 battlefield medical droids]].<ref name="SW:GB" />

*The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] used [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droids]] as medics for its [[Alliance Army/Legends|army]].<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
According to the novel ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Lost Legion'', Phase 1 clone trooper medics have their squad color markings on their [[Clone training armor/Legends|armor]], circles on their shoulder plates, and a thin stripe around their helmets. However, they may not have markings at all, for Kix in "[[The Deserter]]" doesn't have any on his armor. When Kix changes his [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] to [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II]], his new [[Armor/Legends|armor]] displays the clone trooper medic markings.

In the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]], medics are produced by each of the eight civilizations at [[Command center]]s for 50 units of food. In the Trade Federation's bonus campaign, an alternate version of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Grassy Plains]], two medical droids join [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] at the battle.
